ownerGuidance: The preliminary design must find what will actually work and inform the Fusion design; existing Fusion CAD does not constrain it. Each carried item below is a premise with its evidence and its replacement trigger.

replaceIf.chassis: A mass evaluation that cannot hold the R103 margin without structural savings, a bumper or battery packaging result that needs a different perimeter or corner, or a scoring architecture that needs other module stations or landings
replaceIf.panPackage: A retention result needing a retainer, latch or different stow and receive geometry; a physical dock test outside the 1.828 mm support margin; or a mass result needing the inlet or cassette lightened
replaceIf.tapsAndScrews: Replacement of the chassis, or a load and maintenance review that rejects the clamp

interface: Iteration 002 chassis: 146 fabricated bodies, four SDS MK4i L2 NEO modules and four seated 91251A542 clamp screws
reason: The layout carries the existing 002 chassis forward as a revisable premise rather than starting greenfield. Six issued chassis revisions converged on it (cad/issue-001 to issue-006, registered master 002-connected-machining-654-r6); the occupied-shape replay closed with all eight retained bodies in the same occupied form; and the four purchased screws are seated in the tapped nutbars on the selected STEP.
reopen: The bumper outline: the lower cassette corners set a 17.25 mm rear cutback, not the recorded 57.8 mm chamfer
Any change at the four module stations, the upper pan stringers or the pan-truss landings
